name: code-shift
description: Guided, any-direction migration of repositories, pull/merge requests, branch policies, pipelines, and issues across Azure DevOps, GitHub, and GitLab. Every run starts with a read-only dry-run preview, migrates only the resource types you select, and asks for explicit confirmation before each destructive change. No PATs — it reuses your existing az / gh / glab CLI and MCP sessions.
